entries.headline: Mainland China Open Beta on All Platforms
entries.summary: The UE5 MMORPG developed by Kuai Shou's Zhidan Universe begins its open beta in mainland China today, with PC, iOS, and Android clients available for download. Current information confirms mainland China release; no simultaneous announcement for other regions has been seen.
entries.verification: The original brief opened the game's official website and TapTap official page; only the date is confirmed, no precise server opening time provided.
entries.timeNote: Original brief only confirms 2026-08-21; exact server opening time pending verification.

entries.headline: First Reviews Show Clear Divergence
entries.summary: RPG Site's PC review gives 6/10, citing weak late-game narrative, balance, and performance; Noisy Pixel gives 6.5/10, praising the strategy loop but criticizing AI and repetitive management; Cubed3's Switch 2 review gives 8/10, endorsing the six campaigns and hybrid gameplay. OpenCritic aggregated at 73 with 45% recommendation at the time, for trend reference only.
entries.verification: All three scores come from the reviewers' own full review pages; original brief did not confirm precise publication times.
entries.timeNote: Each original review only shows 2026-08-20 date; exact times pending verification.

entries.headline: Riot to End Ongoing Content Development in Late 2026
entries.summary: Riot says the game did not achieve player retention sufficient for long-term development. Servers will continue running, but ranked, seasons, events, battle passes, and KO points will end; all characters will be unlocked, and eligible purchases will be refunded.
entries.verification: Original brief cross-reported by two media outlets, but Riot's primary page was not saved; migration changes to media relay of official info.

entries.headline: Management Buyout Complete, Studio Independent Again
entries.summary: Studio CEO Guillaume Provost confirms the deal closed on August 11. Compulsion now re-owns IPs including Contrast, We Happy Few, and South of Midnight; future sales revenue will directly support studio operations.
entries.verification: Original brief marked this as media report; VGC original report page serves as factual source for this item.

entries.headline: UK Recommended Retail Price Rises £24 from September 1

entries.headline: Rhythm Heaven Groove Cumulative Nearly 874,000
entries.summary: Famitsu estimates two-week sales of 139,363 units; Splatoon Raiders at 64,921 units; Reincarnated Beast PS5 version leads new releases with 48,157 units. Switch 2 hardware sales estimated at 65,560 units during the same period.
entries.verification: Original brief explicitly marked as media statistics; retains Gematsu's compilation link of Famitsu data.

entries.headline: Hands-On and Miyazaki Interview
entries.summary: Kirk McKeand's Guardian hands-on article details three-phase elimination, Virtue scoring, AI enemies, and temporary cooperation, noting UI clutter and randomness risks. VGC's interview with Miyazaki further confirms the design focus is not pure PvP but dynamic situations formed by lurking, observing, AI companions, and intervening in other players' battles.
entries.verification: Both links are the original hands-on article and original interview page; treated as primary sources by content type.

entries.headline: Exhibition Sold Out for First Time, Opening Night Live Lineup Further Revealed
entries.summary: Andy Robinson's interview with Geoff Keighley confirms the two-hour August 25 stream will showcase projects including Gears of War: E-Day, Final Fantasy VII Revelation, and The Witcher 3 expansion 'Songs of the Past'. The article also directly discusses the coexistence of editorial content and paid showcases in Opening Night Live, adding information on the event's business model.
entries.verification: VGC is the original interview, Gamescom official site used for cross-checking event dates; original links retained.

entries.headline: 'Cyberleek' Footage Raises Likelihood of Access to Playable Build
entries.summary: New video shows the leaker spelling 'LEEK' on a wall by shooting, appearing more like real-time interaction than pre-recorded footage; multiple outlets believe this increases credibility of holding or having accessed a playable version, but AI forgery and other possibilities cannot be fully ruled out. Rockstar and Take-Two have not confirmed the source; claims about 'paying $350,000 for a build' or 'hacking an Indian studio' lack reliable independent corroboration and are not included as fact this round.
entries.verification: Original brief explicitly marked as rumor and stated official non-confirmation; did not spread download links.

entries.headline: Union Members Rally Across North America Against Xbox Layoff Plans
entries.summary: Game Developer reports hundreds of union members rallied in multiple US and Canadian locations against Xbox's planned reduction of approximately 3,200 positions. Since the report page lacks verifiable specific publication time and the event predates this window, the original brief treated it as a time-pending observation, not a confirmed headline.
entries.verification: Game Developer is the original bylined report; exact publication time unverifiable, time pending retained.
entries.timeNote: Event occurred 2026-08-19; report published August 20 without specific time.
